name: agent-readiness
description: Score how AI-ready a code repository, monorepo, or multi-repo workspace is and apply the single highest-priority deterministic fix via the agent-readiness-mcp server (>=0.8.0). Always calls inspect_tool first, then exactly one of scan_repo_tool / scan_monorepo_tool / scan_workspace_tool. Each scan opens an onboarding wizard so the user confirms type and picks repos before any scanning starts.
